entries.german:
1281. 12. November. Apnd Rosenberch. — Heinrich von Rosenberg schenkt dem Stifte Hohenfurt fünf Dörfer nebst einem Wald und tauscht ron eben dem selben gegen drei andere Dörfer das Dorf Sonnberg wieder ein.

XXX. In nomine sanete et indiuidue trinitatis patris et filii el spirilus sancti amen. Cum eorum que geruntur in tempore, obliuio solet me- moriam resecare, necesse est, ea tam testium quam scripture muni- mine conlirmari. Vnde nouerint vniuersi Christi fideles presentes litteras visuri vel audituri, quod ego Henricus de Rosenberch de consensu et voluntate expressa vxoris mee Elyzabeth plurimorumque parentum meorum pro remedio, quod dominus Wocko pie memorie pater meus in dccessn suo pro sao suorumque parentum salute ani- marum ecclesie gloriose perpetueque virginis dei genitricis Marie sue fuudationi scilicet in Altovado ordinauit, fraterque meus Witigo in sua morte confirmando renouauit remedium, scilicet ¡mnuatim sili- ginis modiorum quatuor argenti marcarum decem, venerabili domino Ade abbati totique conuentni ad edificationem dicte ecclesie de Alto vado ordinis Cystercieusis ob reuerentiam sanete trinitatis et glo riose dei genilricis virginis Marie villas subscriptas pleno jure omni- umque meorum posterorum liberorumceterorumque heredummeorum omni contradictione postposita contuli beniuole in perpetuum per- mansuras. Quare predictus dominus Adam abbas eiusque conuentus pro remedio supradicto omnibusque dampnis ex ipsius subtractione remedii eidem ecclesie illatis patrem et fratrem meum pie memorie, me et meos beredes per presentes litferas nunc et in posterum sub gratia mee conscience liberos confirmant et solutos. �?ec autem sunt ville: Nebersyhuew et ea in quaresidebat Olthardus, itemHodennitz, Vzahratky, Oppach cum omnibus harum quinque villarum pertinen- tiis scilicet cum terris pratis herbis nemoribus et pascuis in bosco in montibus in piano in aquis in viis et semitis et omnibus aliis libe- ralitatibus et emunitatibus (sic) suis. Item siluam, que sita est inter Nebersyhuew et metas domini Bauwari, in superscriptarum villarum confirmans libertate. Item pro quadam villa, que vocatur Sunnberch, tres villas scilicet Stoiechingen, et ipsam in qua residebat Brazzlaus, et tertiam plagam domini Gerberti bone memorie, quam exstirpauit Jur, eisdem predicta confirmans libertate libere contuli et benigne. In cuius rei testimonium presentes litteras mei munimine sigilli dedi roboratas. Huius facti sunt testes: Dominus Wernhardus de Schaum- berch, filii eius Henricus Wernhardus , et frater eius Henricus; do minus Hoierius de Lomniz et filius eius Zmielo; Wocko de Witi- genafi, Henricus et Wocko de Chrumnau, Vlricus et Otto fratres de Nouadomo, Henricus de Hôritz, Zmielo de Zmielenberch, Wernhar dus Pibro, dominus Jacobus plebanus inRosenberch, dominus Vlricus plebanus in Predol, dominus Theodericus plebanus in Rosental, dominus Creno purchrauius de Pribenitz, dominus Benata purchrauius de Rosenberch, dominus Andreas, dominus Blasius milites mei, Leu- poldus camerarius, Troianus procurator et fratres sui Tschaztolaus et Bôzlaus; Alwich et frater suus Leutoldus de Vinchenhaim, Virions de Weichselen et frater suus Psedborius, Wutzlaus lilius domini 36 Benate, Tschenko et filius eius Duursat et fratres eius Radozt et o Dominicus; Vlricus deEichorns et frater suus Jan, Rödolfus deGuseii et filius eius Vlricus, Jacobus Ladennicer et frater eius; Vlricus Chreno filius domini Chrenonis, Qual et frater suus Eberhardus filii Oduleni, Syboto judex, et ceteri quam plures. entries.english: On 12 November 1281 at Rosenberg, Heinrich von Rosenberg, with the express consent of his wife Elisabeth and many of his relatives, grants five villages and a forest to Abbot Adam and the convent of Hohenfurt. The grant fulfils the spiritual benefit established by his late father Wok and renewed at his death by Heinrich’s brother Witigo: an annual payment to the monastery of four measures of rye and ten marks of silver for the salvation of their souls. In return, the abbot and convent declare Heinrich’s late father and brother, Heinrich, and his heirs free from that obligation and from any losses the monastery had incurred through withdrawal of the payment. The five villages are Nebersyhuew, including the place where Olthardus lived, Hodennitz, Vzahratky, and Oppach; together with all five villages’ lands, meadows, grasses, woods, pastures, and other rights and immunities. He also grants the forest between Nebersyhuew and Lord Bauwar’s boundaries. In exchange for Sonnberg, he grants Stoiechingen, the village where Brazzlaus lived, and the estate of the late Lord Gerbert, cleared by Jur, with the same liberties. Witnesses: Lord Wernhard von Schaumberg, his sons Heinrich and Wernhard, and his brother Heinrich; Lord Hoierius von Lomniz and his son Zmielo; Wocko von Witigenau; Heinrich and Wocko von Krum(l)au; the brothers Ulrich and Otto von Nouadomo; Heinrich von Höritz; Zmielo von Zmielenberg; Wernhard Pibro; Lord Jacob, parish priest at Rosenberg; Lord Ulrich, parish priest at Predol; Lord Theoderich, parish priest at Rosental; Lord Creno, burgrave of Pribenitz; Lord Benata, burgrave of Rosenberg; Lords Andreas and Blasius, Heinrich’s knights; Leupoldus, chamberlain; Troianus, procurator, and his brothers Tschaztolaus and Bôzlaus; Alwich and his brother Leutoldus von Vinchenhaim; Virions von Weichselen and his brother Psedborius; Wutzlaus, son of Lord Benata; Tschenko, his son Duursat, and Tschenko’s brothers Radozt and Dominicus; Ulrich von Eichorns and his brother Jan; Rödolfus von Guseii and his son Ulrich; Jacobus Ladennicer and his brother; Ulrich Chreno, son of Lord Chreno; Qual and his brother Eberhard, sons of Odulenus; Syboto the judge; and many others. The charter was sealed and enacted at Rosenberg on the day after the feast of Saint Martin, 1281. The well-preserved seal formerly hung from violet-yellow-red silk, as in no. XXII. Reference: Millauer, p. 82, no. 15.
